title: Education Benefits Schedule of Full-Time Measures by Resident Term Length
content:
**Schedule — full-time measure of the resident term, for the rate of pursuit confirmed on a monthly verification under Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education).**

The credits counted for the resident term — the latest certification on the benefit whose courses are not all distance learning — are measured against a full-time measure that follows the term's length in weeks: the days from term start to term end, both counted, divided by 7.

| Length of the resident term | Full-time measure |
|---|---|
| Shorter than 10 weeks | 6 credit hours |
| At least 10 weeks and shorter than 15 weeks | 9 credit hours |
| 15 weeks or longer | 12 credit hours (the full-time standard) |

*Footnotes to the schedule*

1. The week count is not rounded: a term of 69 days is 9.86 weeks and is measured against 6 credit hours; a term of 70 days is exactly 10 weeks and is measured against 9 credit hours.
2. A term of 104 days is 14.86 weeks and is measured against 9 credit hours; a term of 105 days is exactly 15 weeks and is measured against 12 credit hours.
3. *Hypothetical:* 6 credits counted in an 8-week term of 56 days are 6 credits against a measure of 6, a full measure; the same 6 credits in a 16-week term are measured against 12.
